senses.gloss: adhaḥ, cf. s-ādha-ūrdhva (IE 8-5); what is below the surface of the ground; root-crops.
ādhāna, cf. dān-ādhāna-vikraya (IE 8-5); mortgaging. Cf. n=ādheyaṃ na ca vikreyam (Ep. Ind., Vol. XXV, p. 218).
ādhavāpa, also called āḍhakavāpa (IE 8-6), ‘an area of land requiring one āḍhaka measure of seed grains for being sown’; a land measure which was not the same in all ages and localities.
